TABLE.NAME: tool_bass_config
TABLE.COMMENT: Named configurations of one activity type's settings: per course (courseid > 0) or site-wide admin presets (courseid = 0)

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: Course the configuration belongs to; 0 for an admin preset

FIELD.NAME: modname
FIELD.COMMENT: The activity type (module name) the configuration belongs to

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: The configuration's name, unique within the course (or among the presets) and type

FIELD.NAME: data
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON snapshot of the ticked settings and their values (and, for a course, the ticked activities)

INDEX.NAME: coursetypename
INDEX.COMMENT: One configuration per name and type in a course or among the presets
